seo_title: All-day breakfast on the left bank — Almaty district
seo_description: Frnds is a pizzeria and coffee shop on Astana's left bank: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. Breakfast, pizza, pasta and coffee daily, 09:00 to 23:00.
h1: An unhurried day off: from Almaty district over to us on the left bank
body:
On weekdays Almaty district keeps its own rhythm: out to work in the morning, back again in the evening, and the far side of the city never quite makes the list. On a day off that rhythm loosens its grip. Nowhere to be by nine, nobody running late, and suddenly crossing the river turns out to be something you can do for no reason at all — for a breakfast eaten sitting down instead of on the move. We are on the left bank, in the Esil district, at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. If you already come over to this side on Saturdays, for errands or just for a walk, consider the reason to stop in already found.

Breakfast does not end at noon here. We are open from nine in the morning until eleven at night, and you can order it that whole time: at one in the afternoon, at six, late in the evening. A day off rarely begins with an alarm — you wake when you wake, get ready slowly, drive over, and nobody tells you the kitchen has moved on to lunch. And if someone in your group is in the mood for lunch exactly, there is nothing to argue about: pizza, pasta, soups, salads, panuozzo and desserts are all on the same menu. Breakfast and dinner share a table quite peacefully.

Now for what to pour alongside it. Our coffee is specialty: it comes down to the bean and how it is brewed, not the size of the cup. If coffee is not going down this morning, take one of our signature teas. In the heat, the cold drinks save the day — iced tea, lemonades, smoothies. And a milkshake is good for finishing breakfast the way you finished any good day as a kid. All of this is better chosen slowly: on a day off nobody is hurrying you, and there is no shame in a second glass.

If you are coming from the other end of town, look us up first: Frnds has 4.kz shows what it looks like inside. Ask us anything — about the menu, about hours — on WhatsApp: +7 707 480 92 15. You do not have to leave empty-handed either: whatever you liked, we will pack to go. And if some Sunday morning in Almaty district turns out too quiet, you know where to drive.
landmarks: Almaty district lies in the eastern part of Astana, among its residential blocks, while Frnds is on the opposite side of the city, across the river. Look for the left bank, Esil district, 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street.
cta: Set aside one morning of your weekend and drive over to the left bank — breakfast will be waiting for you any time up to eleven at night.
